outcome: sialo-form/neutral-form (SF/NF) ratio of N-glycans in maternal and infant serum
cohort: The study included 15 mother-infant pairs whose serum samples were collected at 12 weeks postpartum and categorized based on maternal BMI and GDM status.
finding: Observed differences in maternal and infant IgG N-glycosylation profiles suggest potentially selective placental transfer mechanisms in the context of maternal obesity and GDM.
